features: Important — Fixed a bug when recording invoices: a line with 0% VAT was saved with the standard 22% rate. The preview showed the correct amount while typing, but the saved document came out with VAT applied; entering any non-zero rate worked correctly. The form treated zero as "rate not entered" and replaced it with the default value. This affects every VAT-free expense, which in a building are everyday occurrences: bank and postal charges, professionals under the flat-rate scheme, receipts. The defect was present both when creating and when editing. If you have recorded invoices with this error, it is worth checking them: the document total is higher than it should be.

Important — Error messages no longer disappear on their own. Until now every message — success or error — faded after three seconds. But an error explains why an operation was refused and what to do instead: making it vanish that quickly amounted to refusing without explaining, and anyone who looked away for a moment only saw that "nothing happened". Error and warning messages now stay until you close them with the X; confirmation messages still dismiss themselves, after six seconds instead of three. Also fixed a defect where closing a message left the notification channel in a dirty state, potentially preventing later messages from appearing.

Important — Reversal is no longer offered on invoices that have recorded payments. Previously the "Reverse" action was available on any invoice: clicking it opened the accounting reversal dialog and only afterwards was the operation refused. Now, on a paid or partly paid invoice, the action appears disabled with the explanation — "reverse the payment first from the Supplier payments section, then the invoice" — shown on hover, and therefore before the click. If the refusal is triggered anyway (for example with the same invoice open in two tabs), a dialog states the reason.

Important — The "Delete" action has been removed from the financial years menu. A financial year is the container for an entire period's journal: deleting it cascaded into the removal of all its entries, detail lines and links to that year's instalments. The safety block introduced in the previous version remains in place, but a command offering an irreversible operation on a cornerstone of the accounts has no place among everyday actions. "Edit" remains available: that is where a year is closed.

The "Direct settlement" page now shows the Movements navigation bar like every other page in the section: it was the only one without it, and offered no direct way to reach Collections, Invoices or Payments.
In the invoice expense register, the "Line total" label no longer wraps onto two lines when the column is narrow.

Fixed a bug on the new "Direct settlement" page: the top navigation bar was not drawn and the page could come up blank. A value the management header uses to build the links to Management sets, Charts of accounts and Instalment plans was missing. The header itself was also made more robust: should a page omit that value in future, at most a few links will be missing rather than the whole bar.

Removed some browser console warnings caused by two interface components used but not declared (the dropdown menu label and separator), in the management pages header and in the buildings list. They caused no visible malfunction, but cluttered the diagnostics and made real errors harder to spot.

On the invoice recording and editing pages the dropdown menus in the expense register (right-hand column) looked different from those in the left-hand column: more rounded corners and a taller field. They now match.

Also in the expense register, long labels no longer overflow the field border. A heading carrying the supplier name and the description of the work ended up underneath the clear and open icons, making them unreadable and hard to hit with the pointer. The text is now truncated with an ellipsis and the icons always stay visible in their place.
This update does not change the database structure: no migration to run.
